note: B23 ground floor, L'atelier: the garage workshop, camera at the south wall facing north. Honey-cream stone walls, sage-green plank panels, tool pegboards, roof beams, grey concrete floor. Landmark: the little cream car up on the blue lift. Feminine LEFT: woman in a headscarf with a frying pan over the steaming engine of the broken-down blue car (panne); mole at the workbench holding up the gearbox (transmission); otter in goggles at the wheel of the little cream car on the lift (auto); hen nesting with a cracked egg and yolk in the rusty green banger (bagnole); bear leaning on and polishing the long black saloon (berline). Masculine RIGHT: dachshund pulling the red hand-brake lever (frein, centre); gnu with a hoof on the tyre (pneu); bear mechanic in a jester's cap working on the brake caliper of a wheel (garagiste); moustached chauffeur bowing with the car key to the cat in the fur coat (chauffeur); blue jay with a tiny suitcase on the waiting chair (passager). Exits: barn doors on the left wall -> B23_route (square and fountain visible); glass-paned back door -> R_road_03_z1 station-service (red pumps visible); wooden stairs up at the back right -> R_road_02 loft; green back door right -> R_road_01 traffic garden (yard visible). Painted 2026-10-22 (track s08p4).
